verdict.rationale: Amplitude's data-model docs describe a workflow where an experiment is built in a separate non-production project and then copied into the prod project. That implies a first-party way to test in isolation from production data, but the evidence is a single thin mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dev/staging/sandbox projects or environments, how data isolation from production is guaranteed, programmatic (API/agent) access to sandbox environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Then, copy the experiment into the prod project to run the experiment in prod.
